classifications.description: Array of per-segment classifications. Must contain one entry for each segment in the input batch.

segment_id.description: The 'seg' index from the input, as a string (e.g. '1', '2').

glaser_data_type.description: Glaser data type for this segment.

is_interviewer.description: true if this segment is interviewer speech (question, instruction, metadata).

rationale.description: One sentence justifying the classification with textual evidence.
